SUMMARY.md:
> Every response carries the full provenance of each data point: the publishing
> organisation, report title, publication date, page or table locator, the verbatim
> sentence the value was extracted from, and a working link to the original document.
>
> Data is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Attribution is required and should name
> the original publisher, linking back to the permanent record.
>
> **Authentication is optional.** Anonymous callers get 1,000 requests per day per IP. A free API key raises this to 10,000. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer so_live_…`. Non-JSON endpoints (/industries/{slug}/export.xlsx, /industries/{slug}/export.csv, /indicators/{slug}/export.xlsx, /indicators/{slug}/export.csv, /regions/{slug}/export.xlsx, /regions/{slug}/export.csv) were removed on 2026-10-23: the SDK reads JSON.
